_rules: Only profiles with status 'published' render. Every fact cites one or more entries in that profile's sources array by index. Scope is public identification and impact only: no fuze internals, arming, render-safe or charge details.

profiles.name: PMN-2

facts.label: Appearance
facts.text: Plastic body, usually green and occasionally brown, with a black rubber cross on top.

facts.label: Reported in
facts.text: Afghanistan, Angola, Azerbaijan, Cambodia, Chechnya, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Georgia, Honduras, Lebanon, Mozambique, Nicaragua, Tajikistan and Thailand.

facts.label: Ukraine
facts.text: A Ukrainian diplomat at the OSCE stated that Ukraine destroyed its inherited PMN-2 stock by 2011, and that Russia, which has not joined the Mine Ban Treaty, continues to use the mine.

facts.label: Detection
facts.text: Generally considered detectable with a good metal detector.

sources.name: Bulletpicker, citing Explosive Ordnance Guide for Ukraine (2022)

profiles.review_note: Secondary sources. Replace with GICHD, CAT-UXO or national mine action authority references before launch.
